handoff: Review approved: AC1–AC7 met with S1 integration tests; one shared validator for observe and doctor; housekeeping tests and typecheck green. One minor finding (F1): doctor --repo still builds runner/remote ports, which throws when a configured external adapter package is missing.

findings.title: --repo builds the runner, remote and notifier adapters it never uses
findings.detail:
repoGroup calls ctx.ports() (buildPorts in packages/cli/src/wiring.ts:54) only to get the agents' skill folders. That also resolves the runner, remote and notifier factories. When the config names an external adapter package that is not installed (`external()`), `doctor --repo` throws, even though B10 says it needs no runner or remote. Built-in adapters only get constructed, so the tests and AC7 pass. The handoff already notes this.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Build only the agent adapters for the skill check: a buildAgents helper, or give ports() a lazy agents-only path.
